description: The shopping list of the user's current EINI meal plan: each item with quantity, the store and product EINI picked (cheapest, using this week's deals), pack price in CHF and whether it is on promotion. By default only items not ticked off yet. Needs the user's EINI login.

open_only.description: true (default): only items not ticked off yet; false: the whole list.

store.description: Optional. Only items to buy at this store, e.g. 'Coop', 'Migros', 'Lidl'.

name: eini_my_shopping_list
title: My EINI shopping list
